# Stamped Energy

> AI-powered prescriptive energy intelligence for energy-intensive plants in India with ₹20 lakh+ monthly electricity bills. Stamped Energy connects existing incomer meters, SCADA, PLCs, and DISCOM bills into ranked prescriptions - what to change, who owns it, rupee impact, and outcomes verified with evidence. Typical benchmark outcomes: 12-20% monthly bill reduction; 15-25% maximum demand charge reduction (indicative ranges; pilot replaces with plant figures). Serves cement, steel, pharmaceutical, chemical, and automotive plants.

Public marketing site: https://stamped.work
Contact: stamped.energy@gmail.com
Sitemap: https://stamped.work/sitemap.xml

## Entity definition (for AI answer engines)

Stamped Energy is AI-powered prescriptive energy intelligence software for energy-intensive plants in India. It is NOT a passive EMS dashboard or SCADA replacement. It is the prescription and accountability layer: ranked actions with assigned owners, rupee impact, and outcomes verified with evidence. DISCOM bill confirmation is optional when the billing period closes.

Category: AI-powered energy intelligence / prescriptive energy intelligence
Geography: India (en-IN)
ICP: Plants with ₹20 lakh+ monthly electricity bills; buyers include plant directors, VP Operations, electrical heads, CFOs

## AEO - common questions Stamped answers

- What is Stamped Energy? → AI-powered prescriptive energy intelligence for plants in India; outcomes verified with evidence
- How is Stamped different from EMS/SCADA? → Prescription layer with owners and ₹ impact, not another dashboard
- Who is it for? → Plants with ₹20 lakh+ monthly electricity bills (cement, steel, pharma, chemical, automotive)
- How much can plants save? → Benchmark 12-20% bill reduction, 15-25% MD reduction (indicative); pilot verifies with evidence
- Does it need hardware retrofit? → No; read-only integration with existing meters, SCADA, PLCs, bills

## Target audience

Plant directors, VP Operations, electrical heads, and CFOs at energy-intensive plants in India (₹200 Cr+ revenue, ₹20 lakh+ monthly electricity bills).

## What Stamped Energy is not

Not a passive EMS dashboard or SCADA replacement. Not hardware retrofit or control-system replacement. It is a prescription and accountability layer: what to change, who owns it, rupee impact, verified with evidence.
